root_cause.title: Planner raw novelty embedded in base_score survives portfolio gating
root_cause.mechanism: ERV = base_score + portfolio_adjustments. base_score = sum(planner components) includes components['novelty'] from _novelty_bonus (tool-not-attempted heuristic). 3H.11 apply_novelty_valuation_bridge gates only novelty_component = novelty * (WEIGHT_NOVELTY_PORTFOLIO/2) added in portfolio layer. When valuation_class=REPRESENTATION_NOVELTY_ONLY, portfolio novelty zeros but raw planner novelty (up to 2.0) remains in base_score.
root_cause.effect: Representation-only candidates retain false novelty rank boost of up to WEIGHT_NOVELTY (2.0) even when 29 portfolio gates fire. Rank comparison uses expected_research_value which still embeds ungated planner novelty.
root_cause.where_semantic_arrives_too_late: Semantic classification runs inside build_opportunity_from_candidate but only adjusts portfolio novelty_component, not the planner novelty already summed into base_score. Both plan_next_action and select_global_research_opportunity use ERV for ranking — so gating is structurally incomplete.

t4_decision_4.note: ERV includes base_score planner novelty + portfolio novelty; gating on portfolio layer alone insufficient when planner novelty dominates rank margin

chosen_architecture.option: B — post-planner rank reconciliation at ERV computation
chosen_architecture.rationale: Single integration point in build_opportunity_from_candidate reconciles base_score planner novelty using existing 3H.11 valuation_class. Feeds both plan_next_action adjusted_scores and global allocator ERV. Does not move portfolio logic into planner, does not retune weights, does not duplicate classifier.
chosen_architecture.formula: reconciled_base = base_score - raw_planner_novelty + gate(raw_planner_novelty, valuation_class); ERV uses reconciled_base + gated_portfolio_novelty + other components
